verdict.rationale: The only first-party segmentation evidence is a 'Predictive Segmentation' line on the pricing page. There is also a mention that Magento purchase data can be used to send targeted emails. Together these show Mailchimp ships some segmentation of its own, but nothing describes how segments are built or whether they update automatically. Missing for 10: documented segment building from profile attributes/merge fields, tag-based segment conditions, behavioral-event conditions, evidence that segments stay live and dynamic as data changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
